changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Update existing messages to set message_type based on piece_jointe
changeSet.sql: UPDATE message SET message_type = 'IMAGE' WHERE piece_jointe IS NOT NULL AND piece_jointe LIKE '%images/%' AND message_type = 'TEXT'
UPDATE message SET message_type = 'VOICE' WHERE piece_jointe IS NOT NULL AND piece_jointe LIKE '%voice/%' AND message_type = 'TEXT'
